configuration.title: OpenCode
opencode.path.description: Override the opencode binary path. Leave empty to auto-detect (PATH, then the bundled CLI from the OpenCode desktop app).
opencode.serverUrl.description: Connect to an already running opencode v2 server (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4096) instead of spawning one per window.
opencode.serverPassword.description: Password for the external server configured in opencode.serverUrl (Basic auth user is always "opencode").
opencode.context.autoAttachSelection.des: Automatically attach the active editor's selection as context when sending a message.
opencode.context.maxSelectionLength.desc: Maximum number of characters of the active selection to attach.
opencode.notifications.turnComplete.desc: Show a notification when a turn finishes.
opencode.notifications.permissionRequest: Show a notification when the agent asks for permission.
opencode.notifications.errors.descriptio: Show a notification when the agent or the server reports an error.
